sections.title: Salon operations and customer care
fields: State stylist experience/training, languages, age groups, child-service arrangements, walk-in/appointment availability and booking notice. Reuse profile contacts and opening hours.
Service menu, extras and booking policies
Give starting prices, inclusions, length/thickness/product/senior-stylist charges, duration, deposits, cancellation, rescheduling, late/no-show terms, payment methods and package validity.

Describe tool disinfection, single-use items, fresh linen, ingredient disclosure, product sourcing/storage/expiry, sensitivity screening and product-specific manufacturer testing instructions. Explain consent, service limits, incidents, complaints, aftercare, corrections and separate promotional-photo permission. Upload applicable permissions, claimed training/brand certificates, menu and authorised portfolio; reuse profile documents.
Choose Yes when salon services are available at the customer location.
Home service areas, charges and setup

State home/event areas and PIN codes, outstation availability, eligible services, slots, minimum booking, travel/accommodation charges, staff identification, supplied products/equipment, seating, lighting, power, workspace, setup time and cleanup.

sections.title: Medical supply safety and rental
fields: Describe applicable licences/validity, supplier checks, product evidence, storage, expiry rotation, recall notices and complaint escalation. Reuse profile documents. Provide catalogue, authorisations where claimed and relevant safety evidence; never upload patient records. Sales do not imply authority to diagnose or prescribe.
Choose Yes only if medical equipment rental is available.
State duration, deposit, installation/delivery charges, servicing, cleaning, damage responsibilities and collection terms.

sections.title: Care delivery and safeguards
fields: State centre/home/transport availability, areas/PIN codes, travel limits, booking notice, confirmation times and per-session/visit/hour/shift/day/journey charges. Explain equipment, consumables, travel and extra-staff charges, inclusions, cancellation, refunds and replacements.

Describe eligibility assessment, consent, authorised family contacts, staff identity checks, safeguarding, supervision, infection control, equipment maintenance, incidents, complaints and emergency escalation. Clarify medicine/equipment responsibilities and service limits. Supply applicable registrations, permissions, insurance and training evidence; no patient care records or photos.

sections.title: Testing, reports and sample collection
fields: Test preparation, prices and report delivery

Give provider-approved preparation instructions, test/package prices and extra charges, turnaround times, delay notices, secure report delivery and authorised recipients. State cancellation, repeat-sample and correction policies. Do not enter patient data.
Quality control, sample handling and critical results

Describe identification/consent, infection control, maintenance, quality checks, labelling, storage, transport, rejected samples, waste handling and critical-result escalation. Provide applicable approvals and claimed accreditation scope/validity; reuse existing documents.
Choose Yes only for home sample collection. This is separate from a clinical home visit.
Home collection coverage, fees and safeguards
State areas/PIN codes, slots, notice, charges, eligible tests, collector qualifications/identification, sample transport and failed-collection terms.

sections.title: Vision and hearing product support
fields: Product care, warranty and customer safeguards

Explain authenticity checks, fitting/customisation charges, cleaning, care instructions, repairs, warranty, exchanges, complaints and consent/privacy practices. Upload applicable credentials and dealer evidence only where claimed; never upload patient prescriptions, reports or photographs.
Choose Yes if optical or hearing products can be delivered.
Product delivery areas, charges and timelines
State delivery areas/PIN codes, charges, expected timelines, pickup options and failed-delivery terms.

sections.title: Dental safety and aftercare
fields: Describe sterilisation, instrument handling, applicable waste-disposal arrangements, treatment consent, emergency preparedness and written aftercare. Explain complaints and referral arrangements. Do not include patient information.

sections.title: Healthcare provider credentials & services
fields: Provider type, public contacts and accessibility
Reuse profile name and address. State facility or practitioner type, appointment phone/email, languages, website, accessibility and walk-in or appointment-only access.

For every clinician, provide professional name, role, qualifications, recognised speciality, registration authority/number/status or validity, experience, schedule and publication consent. Attach a roster if needed. Facility registration does not replace practitioner verification.

Describe outpatient/inpatient services, beds, diagnostics, pharmacy, relevant care units and ambulance/referral arrangements only where available. Do not imply unverified emergency, intensive-care or maternity capability.
State opening and clinician hours, appointment duration, booking notice, in-person availability, age groups and follow-up scheduling. Distinguish 24-hour opening from emergency care.
Consultation fees, payments and booking policies
State fees and inclusions, follow-up terms, cancellation/rescheduling/refunds, payment methods and confirmed insurance/cashless arrangements. Separate procedure, investigation and admission charges.

Describe consent, confidential appointment/record handling, access and retention, guardian consent for minors, chaperones and accessibility. Do not enter patient records, diagnoses or identity documents.
Patient support, complaints and emergency instructions
Provide public support and escalation contacts, complaint handling and clear emergency instructions. Platform booking is not an emergency-response service.

State applicable facility/service approvals, jurisdiction, authority, references and validity; explain non-applicability. Attach practitioner credentials, representative authority and accreditation evidence only if claimed. Include patient-free facility photos; reuse profile documents.
Choose Yes only for a verified emergency-care service.
State staffed hours, emergency contact, actual capabilities, ambulance coverage and referral arrangements. Do not claim 24-hour emergency care unless verified.
Choose Yes only when remote consultations are available within the practitioner scope.
Describe booking, clinician identification, consent, privacy, fees and limitations, including referral to in-person or emergency care when needed.
Choose Yes only if clinician home visits are offered.
State areas/PIN codes, clinician availability, appointment terms, visit charges and services within scope.

Confirm authority and clinician consent to publish professional details, accurate credentials/fees/services, confidentiality and no misleading accreditation or outcome claims. Onboarding does not replace regulatory approval.

sections.title: Fashion retail fit, quality & care
fields: Disclose materials, plating and product condition. Distinguish imitation jewellery from precious metals. Provide evidence for brand, hypoallergenic, material or water-resistance claims; do not make unsupported claims.
Fit, size exchanges and hygiene conditions
Explain size systems, fit guidance, exchange timelines, tags/packaging and condition requirements, hygiene restrictions and personalised-item terms without excluding applicable customer rights.
Care, repair providers and spare parts
Give care instructions, repair/replacement-part availability, charges and timelines. Identify store, manufacturer or third-party service; state Not offered where applicable.

sections.title: Fashion services & studio operations
fields: Describe shop, home, online or doorstep work, customer groups, appointment availability and experience. Reuse profile contact and address details.
Explain measurements, size charts, fittings, who supplies fabric, inspection, design/colour/sample approval, approved measurements and return of leftover customer fabric.

State starting prices, materials, consultation/measurement charges, fittings, digitisation, urgent work, minimum quantity/value, bulk discounts, advance and balance terms. Keep ready-made product prices in the catalogue.
State daily/monthly or bulk capacity, normal and urgent timelines, minimum notice, fitting schedule, event deadlines and how delays or changes are communicated.
Choose Yes if customer garments or finished orders can be collected or delivered.
Specify pickup and/or delivery, areas and PIN codes, charges, timelines, packaging and signed or digital handover records for customer garments and materials.
Choose Yes only if home visits are offered.
State service areas, visit fees, appointment times, cancellation and safe access arrangements.
Explain finishing checks, included post-delivery alterations, defect/rework remedies and damage or loss of customer garments or fabric.
Cancellation, design changes and uncollected orders
Explain cancellation/refunds, changes after design approval, custom-order conditions and storage/collection terms without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain consent, access, retention/deletion of measurements/photos, permission for marketing images and authority to reproduce customer logos/designs.

sections.title: Clothing, tailoring & occasion orders
fields: State size ranges and measurement guidance. Maintain fabric composition, colours, care instructions, photos, prices and stock in the catalogue; disclose display, used or damaged items.
Choose Yes for stitching, alterations, embroidery or personalisation.
Describe in-store, home-visit or customer-provided measurements, design approval, charges, advances, timelines, included fittings, customer fabric and custom-order cancellation or returns.
Size exchanges, tags and hygiene conditions
Explain exchange timelines, unworn-item and tag requirements, colour or fit guidance, defect remedies and altered/personalised-item restrictions without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain consent, permitted use, access, retention and deletion for measurements or photos; state if none are collected.
Choose Yes only if bridal outfits are available for rental.
Bridal rental, deposit and return terms
Describe availability, duration, rental price, refundable deposit, fittings, collection/return, cleaning, late-return or damage/loss charges, cancellation and deposit-refund terms.
State order cutoffs, pre-order lead times, packaging and wedding/event deadlines. Do not promise dates you cannot meet.

sections.title: Home living orders & aftercare
fields: Choose Yes for made-to-order or personalised products.
Describe measurements, design approval, quotations, advance payments, production times and cancellation or return conditions.
Explain lift or staircase access, upper-floor charges, packaging, handling and transit-damage reporting; state Not applicable for small items.
Describe repair, replacement-part and maintenance support, availability and charges; state services not offered.

sections.title: Electronics sales & support
fields: State physical store, online or both; new, used or refurbished. Keep model specifications, prices, tax inclusion and stock in the product catalogue.
List brands. Claim authorised status only with supporting proof; otherwise state independent retailer.
Choose Yes only if installation or setup is offered.
Choose No for store pickup only.
State service areas, charges, appointment times and whether the store, manufacturer or a third party installs and demonstrates the product.
Distinguish manufacturer and store warranties; include claim contacts, invoice availability, repair support and used/refurbished testing and condition grading.

sections.title: Business & location
fields: State individual/proprietorship/partnership/company and retailer, wholesaler or distributor. Name, owner/contact, phone and email are reused from your partner profile.
Completed years; enter zero for a new business.
Include street, city, state and PIN code. Refer to your profile address if unchanged.
Include the centre name for a shop inside a shopping centre.
Provide a map link for the store or centre.
Include opening/closing times and regular holidays.
Describe parking, step-free access, lifts and other facilities accurately; state unavailable facilities where relevant.

sections.title: Products & ordering
fields: Describe the range. Maintain individual descriptions, photos, prices, sizes/variants and stock in the catalogue.
State units and quantity, or No minimum.
Describe quantity discounts, institutional supply and order limits, or Not offered.
Describe services, preparation times, packaging and extra charges, or Not offered.
Explain availability updates, special orders, pre-orders and customer approval before substitutions or price changes.

sections.title: Pickup & delivery
fields: State in-store shopping, pickup, delivery or a combination.
List areas served or enter Delivery not offered.
Include bulk/custom-order lead times and delivery estimates, where applicable.
Describe own/third-party delivery, free-delivery conditions, failed deliveries and pickup instructions; state Not applicable where necessary.
Explain protective packaging and transport handling, or Not applicable.

sections.title: Quality & product safety
fields: Describe supplier checks, traceability and relevant brand/distributor authorisation.
Explain storage, damage checks, withdrawal from sale, recalls and customer notification.
Describe how relevant usage instructions and warnings are supplied. For toys, include age suitability and relevant safety evidence.
Describe manufacturer warranty coverage, exclusions and claim process; otherwise Not applicable.

sections.title: Registration & supporting evidence
fields: Enter applicable references or state why not applicable for review. Reuse tax registration already supplied.
Enter the expiry date where applicable.

Identify store photos, catalogue and relevant registrations, brand authorisation or product compliance evidence. Centre operators should provide management authority and applicable building/occupancy/fire-safety documents. Individual shops need only their own applicable evidence; reuse uploaded profile documents.

sections.title: Customer policies
fields: Describe eligibility, timelines and fees without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain reporting, reasonable evidence, review and remedies; include bulk shortages and damage claims.
Describe design approval, preparation, pre-order timing and cancellation/refund terms, or Not offered.
For printing/personalisation, explain permitted use, access, retention and deletion of customer files. Otherwise enter No customer files collected.

Beauty Parlour: List services, staff experience, facilities, privacy arrangements, duration, prices and packages.
Bridal Makeup: Bridal packages, trials and event arrangements
Describe looks, trials/charges, hair styling and draping inclusions, products, assistants, venue travel, early-hour charges, touch-ups, group capacity and booking lead time.
Makeup Artist: List specialisations, individual/group capacity, brands, consultation, trials, duration, tools/accessories supplied and pricing.
Mehndi Artist: State design styles, bridal/guest packages, coverage, application time, group capacity, ingredients, aftercare and travel charges.
Nail Studio: List manicure/pedicure, extensions, nail art, materials, duration, removal/refills, tool hygiene, pricing and repair policy.
Skin Care: Non-medical skin care and service limits

List non-medical cosmetic services, training, products/equipment, suitability consultation, duration, prices and aftercare. This listing does not authorise medical or invasive procedures; those require separate credential and scope review.
Mens Salon: List haircut, beard and shaving options, stylist availability, duration, prices and packages.
Womens Salon: List hair services, stylist availability, consultation, duration, prices, packages and privacy arrangements.
Unisex Salon: State customer groups, services, stylist specialisations, seating/private-service arrangements and appointment availability.
Haircut: State styles, age groups, consultation, wash/blow-dry inclusions, duration and price differences by hair length or complexity.
Hair Styling: Describe styling/event options, trials, accessories/extensions, preparation, duration and extra charges.
Hair Coloring: State techniques, brands, suitability consultation, manufacturer-required allergy testing, price basis, duration, aftercare and correction policy. Follow each product instructions; do not use one universal allergy-test rule.
Pharmacy: Provide responsible pharmacist qualifications/registration, medicine categories, prescription verification, temperature control, expiry checks, sourcing, recalls and disposal. Do not upload customer prescriptions.
Medical Equipment: List categories, brands/models, intended use, condition, applicable product authorisations, installation, training, maintenance, calibration, warranty and repairs.
Surgical Supplies: List products, manufacturers, sizes, sterile/non-sterile status, single-use/reusable designation, packaging checks, batch traceability, expiry, storage and bulk availability.
Physiotherapy: State therapist credentials, therapy areas, assessment, session duration, centre/home availability, equipment, fees and progress reviews.
Home Nursing: State nurse credentials, services within scope, visits/shifts, availability, care-plan or clinician-order requirements, equipment responsibilities and replacement arrangements.
Elder Care: Non-clinical elder care and caregiver safeguards

Describe companionship, personal/daily-living support, visiting/live-in arrangements, caregiver training and identity checks, supervision, family updates and safeguarding. This service is non-clinical; select Home Nursing for nursing services and supply the relevant credentials.
Rehabilitation Centre: Specify rehabilitation types, professional team, outpatient/inpatient/day-care options, admission assessment, facilities, duration, progress reviews and discharge/follow-up arrangements.
Ambulance Service: Distinguish patient transport from emergency-care capability. State vehicle/equipment details, crew qualifications, hours, coverage, dispatch contact, response limitations and hospital handover. Give base fare, included distance, per-km/waiting/outstation charges and applicable vehicle, fitness, insurance, permit and maintenance evidence. Do not promise unsupported response times.
Diagnostic Centre: List laboratory/imaging services, onsite versus outsourced tests, responsible professionals, facilities, partner laboratories and referral arrangements.
Blood Test Lab: List test categories, accepted sample types, collection hours, processing laboratory and transport arrangements.
Scan Centre: List available ultrasound, CT or MRI services, qualified reporting professionals, duration, referral requirements and provider-approved preparation/safety screening. List applicable permissions and equipment evidence.
X-Ray Centre: List examinations, equipment, responsible professionals, referral requirements, radiation-safety and pregnancy-screening processes, and applicable permissions.
Health Checkup: List package names, included tests/consultations, intended age groups, exclusions, prices, duration, report review and follow-up arrangements.
Eye Hospital: List specialists, diagnostics, surgical facilities, inpatient/outpatient availability and verified emergency or referral arrangements.
Optical Store: List frames, lenses, contact lenses and brands, prescription requirements, fitting services and custom-order timelines. Retail listing does not establish clinical qualifications; select Eye Checkup if offering examinations.
Eye Checkup: Identify the examining professional, qualifications, age groups, examination scope, duration, fees, separately charged tests and referral arrangements.
ENT Clinic: Describe practitioner credentials, ear/nose/throat services, age groups, diagnostic facilities, procedures within scope, consultation fees and follow-up terms.
Hearing Aid Centre: List audiology professional credentials, assessments, hearing-aid brands/types, fitting/programming, trial terms, follow-up adjustments and battery/accessory availability. Do not promise hearing restoration.
Dental Clinic: Describe dental chairs, available services, imaging arrangements, accessibility and referral partners. List only verified facilities.
Dental Checkup: State examination scope, appointment duration, age groups and consultation fee. Identify imaging and other tests charged separately.
Root Canal: Root canal assessment and fee inclusions
Describe assessment, practitioner scope, visit planning and follow-up. State whether imaging, restoration and crowns are included or charged separately; do not guarantee outcomes.
Dental Implant: List practitioner qualifications, implant systems offered, assessment process, itemised estimates and follow-up arrangements. Treatment suitability is decided by the clinician; avoid success guarantees.
Orthodontics: State recognised qualifications, braces or aligners offered, assessment and review scheduling, fee instalments and retainer charges. Duration and outcomes depend on clinical assessment.
Teeth Cleaning: Distinguish routine cleaning from periodontal services. Describe assessment, appointment duration, fees and aftercare information provided by the clinician.
General Hospital: List departments, outpatient/inpatient services, beds, diagnostics, pharmacy and ambulance/referral arrangements.
Multi-Speciality Hospital: List specialities, departments, consultants, inpatient facilities, verified ICU/operating theatres, diagnostics and appointment coordination.
General Physician: State consultation scope, age groups treated, location, hours and referral arrangements. Supply credentials in the practitioner roster.
Specialist Clinic: State recognised speciality, services/procedures within scope, facilities, equipment and referral arrangements; link practitioners to each service.
Childrens Hospital: State age groups, paediatric departments, verified neonatal/paediatric intensive care if available, vaccination services and parent/guardian arrangements.
Womens Clinic: State gynaecology, antenatal or menopause services as applicable, examination facilities, chaperone availability, verified maternity/delivery services and emergency referrals.
Footwear: List mens, womens and kids ranges, footwear types, materials, size charts, fitting assistance, customisation and repairs if offered.
Bags & Luggage: List handbags, backpacks and travel luggage, materials, dimensions/capacity, lock types, personalisation and wheel, handle or zip repair support.
Fashion Jewellery: List product types, base metals/materials, plating, stone descriptions, sizes, customisation and care. Identify fashion/imitation products accurately.
Watches: List brands, analogue/digital/smartwatch ranges, movement types, straps, warranty, battery replacement, strap adjustment and repair support.
Fashion Accessories: List belts, wallets, scarves, hats, hair accessories or other categories, materials, sizes, gift sets, personalisation and bulk availability.
Tailoring: List garment types, custom stitching, alterations, customer-fabric acceptance and fitting services.
Boutique: Describe ready-made/custom collections, fabrics, sizes, personalisation, styling appointments and accessories sold.
Fashion Designer: Describe specialisations, consultation options, portfolio, sketches, fabric sourcing, samples, included revisions and design ownership/usage terms.
Uniform Supplier: List school, corporate, hospitality or industrial uniforms, sizes, fabric specifications, minimum quantities, sample/logo approval, capacity and repeat orders. Provide evidence for any protective-safety claims.
Embroidery Service: Describe hand/machine techniques, garments/fabrics, threadwork/beads, accepted design formats, digitisation fees, sample approval, maximum design size and minimum quantity.
Mens Clothing: Describe casual, formal and occasion wear, fabrics, sizes, ready-made/custom tailoring and alterations.
Womens Clothing: Describe clothing categories, sizes, fabrics, maternity and plus-size options where offered, tailoring and alterations.
Kids Clothing: State age and height ranges, infant/schoolwear, fabrics and relevant safety and care information.
Saree Shop: List saree types, fabrics, weaving styles, blouse-piece inclusion, blouse stitching and fall/pico. Provide evidence for silk or handloom claims when made.
Traditional Wear: List regional and occasion-wear categories, fabrics, sizes, matching family sets and customisation.
Western Wear: Describe categories, brands, fits, sizes, fabrics, seasonal collections and alterations if offered.
Bridal Wear: Describe ready-made/custom bridal collections, appointments, fittings, embroidery, preparation timelines and included accessories.
Furniture Store: List categories, materials, finishes, ready-made or made-to-order options, assembly and old-furniture exchange. Keep dimensions and prices in the catalogue.
Home Decor Store: Describe decor categories, materials, styles, handmade items, personalisation, fragile-item handling and styling assistance.
Mattress Store: List mattress types, sizes, thickness, firmness and custom sizes. Explain trial duration, hygiene conditions, fees and returns separately from warranty, plus old-mattress collection if offered.
Lighting Store: List indoor/outdoor categories, brands, wattage, colour temperature, fittings and smart-lighting compatibility. Describe installation assistance and relevant safety evidence.
Kitchenware Store: List cookware, utensils, storage and dining ranges, materials, induction/gas/oven compatibility, care instructions, sets and bulk availability.
Mobile Store: List smartphone/feature-phone brands, exchange/buyback, setup, data-transfer consent and repair support.
Computer Store: List laptops, desktops, components, custom builds, peripherals, licensed software, bulk orders, repairs and upgrades.
Home Appliance Store: List appliance types and brands, large-item handling, demonstration and old-appliance exchange terms.
Electronics Store: List TVs, audio, cameras, gaming devices and brands; describe setup, demonstrations and after-sales support.
Accessories Store: List accessory categories, supported models, original or third-party status, fitting and bulk availability.
Department Store: List departments, brands, floor-wise directory, customer-service facilities and collection arrangements.
Shopping Centre: Operators: identify management, representation authority, shop directory, facilities, accessibility, parking, security/help desk and emergency arrangements. Individual shops: identify your centre/unit and your own facilities; do not claim operator authority.
Gift Shop: Describe occasion-based collections, wrapping, hampers, personalisation, preparation times, corporate gifting and custom-order approval.
Toy Shop: List categories, brands, age suitability, small-parts warnings, battery requirements and relevant safety/compliance evidence.
Book Store: Describe genres, languages, new/used books, school/college texts, special orders, pre-orders and institutional supply. Keep ISBN, edition, condition and missing/damaged-page disclosures in the catalogue.
Stationery Store: Describe school/office/art/craft ranges, brands, pack sizes, institutional/bulk supply and printing/binding/customisation if offered.
